subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain blocked and be documented/validated as unsupported for Control UI rendering?
rationale: The remaining fix changes browser network-fetch behavior, CSP, privacy expectations, and the public avatar configuration contract, so automation should not pick the policy silently.

options.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Build a same-origin remote-avatar proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned proxy/cache with explicit MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and failure-feedback behavior.

options.title: Allow direct remote image fetches
options.body: Let the browser load arbitrary remote avatar URLs directly, accepting the CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep local/data-only Control UI avatars
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest history signal for the avatar route, resolver, and security-hardening decisions touched by either option.
